tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find localities by name, city name, or the beginning of a postal code. Use this when the user gives a place name and wants its postal code(s), or has a partial code. findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_postal_code" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_postal_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_group · Private data: lookup_postal_code, search_places, get_group · Public sink: get_group · Destructive: list_countries.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_group · Private data: lookup_postal_code, search_places, get_group · Public sink: get_group · Destructive: list_countries

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
